{{Quote|Mirabel, that was our capital. They used thermal detonators to create a firestorm that consumed the whole city. Thousands upon thousands died. Everyone I'd ever cared about. Everyone I'd ever known. My wife. My child.|X-7 to Leia Organa|<ref name="Rebel Force: Target" />}}
'''Mirabel''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Malano III]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] pretended to be a warrior from Malano III in order to gain the trust of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. X-7 told the story of how the Empire destroyed Mirabel with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] when the local populace objected to the Empire's presence.<ref name="Rebel Force: Target" />
